mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_knowledge_upload_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, kb_id, actor_ref, request_fingerprint, status) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid), #{kbId}, #{actor}, #{fingerprint}, 'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT kb_id, actor_ref, request_fingerprint AS fingerprint, status, document_id, source_version, chunks, error_message FROM nw_knowledge_upload_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_knowledge_upload_receipts SET status='SUCCEEDED', document_id=#{documentId}, source_version=#{sourceVersion}, chunks=#{chunks}, completed_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE nw_knowledge_upload_receipts SET status='REJECTED', error_message=#{message}, completed_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND status='PROCESSING'
